Name: Coding Agents
Author: Gabriel Vaz
Description: Live keys for your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI and Gemini CLI. Each key shows one session with its state, timer, current tool or streamed text and a breathing light. Press to open the session's window, hold to approve a permission request. A limits key shows how much of the 5-hour and weekly usage is left.

Actions.Name: Agent Session
Actions.Tooltip: One live coding-agent session per key. Press: open its window. Hold: approve a pending permission request.

Actions.Name: Agents Overview
Actions.Tooltip: How many agents are working, waiting for you and done. Press: open the first session waiting for you. Hold: next page.

Actions.Name: Allow
Actions.Tooltip: Allow the oldest pending permission request (Claude Code, Codex).

Actions.Name: Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Deny the oldest pending permission request (Claude Code, Codex).

Actions.Name: Next Page
Actions.Tooltip: Show the next page of sessions on the session keys. Hold: back to the first page.

Actions.Name: Agent Limits
Actions.Tooltip: How much of the 5-hour and weekly limits is left (Claude Code, Codex) or of each model's quota (Antigravity), and when they reset. Press: refresh.
